content.short: Lets Indian freelancers and exporters get paid by foreign clients straight into their bank.
content.description: DashX is built for Indian freelancers and small exporters working with overseas clients. Clients pay in more than 25 currencies or in stablecoins, and the money lands in the user's Indian bank account, usually within 24 hours, with FIRA documents issued automatically for tax. Users also get invoicing and virtual accounts in 10+ currencies, and its rates beat PayPal's. It is backed by Colosseum.
content.meta: Get paid by international clients in 25+ currencies or stablecoins and settle to your Indian bank with DashX, FIRA included.
content.pageTitle: DashX - Web3 Wallet Tools - Lancers Web3 Explorer
